scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @vuekumi/web & npm run dev -w @vuekumi/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vuekumi/shared && npm run build -w @vuekumi/api && npm run build -w @vuekumi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vuekumi/shared && npm run db:generate -w @vuekumi/api && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && npm run typecheck -w @vuekumi/web
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm exec -w @vuekumi/web -- vite build
